**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

MSL's warranty package meets — and on several points exceeds — the preferred position:

- **Express conformance warranty** (SOW 19.1(a)): all Products, MSL-supplied materials, Parts and work conform in all material respects to IBM specifications/drawings, are of specified quality and good workmanship, and free from defect.
- **Duration**: stated month-based periods for MSL Procured Parts (19.1(a)(iv)) and workmanship (19.1(a)(v)), commencing on delivery, expressly surviving acceptance testing and IBM's test procedure, and covering latent defects including supplier-sourced Parts (19.1(b)).
- **Remedy**: failure analysis, repair or replacement within a committed turnaround with MSL paying return shipping, and a **refund** of MSL's price (plus Parts prices) if repair/replacement is not possible (19.5); plus epidemic-failure recall cost-bearing (19.7) and a clean-title warranty (19.4).
- **Disclaimer does not swallow the warranty**: 19.6(a) is expressly limited to "other terms and conditions" and preserves "MSL'S WARRANTY OBLIGATIONS DESCRIBED IN THIS SECTION 19" — far from the "AS IS" walk-away.

Noted in the rationale but not flagged (minor sub-elements): no standalone "professional and workmanlike" services warranty (subsumed in good workmanship), no express compliance-with-laws or no-malicious-code warranty, and the period figures plus the Section 16.19 survival cut-off are redacted ([*]) in this copy — worth confirming the numeric durations against the unredacted agreement.
